Code — tiny fix. Your delegated tools work under mix test (29 passing) but fail when code.exs is run as a standalone .exs script because IExClaw.Tools.* isn't on the code path.

Fix: near the top of code.exs (after Mix.install, before your inline module definitions), add Code.require_file calls for the three compiled modules so they load alongside your script:

  Code.require_file(Path.expand("../../lib/iex_claw/tools/scope_guard.ex", __DIR__))
  Code.require_file(Path.expand("../../lib/iex_claw/tools/file_system.ex", __DIR__))
  Code.require_file(Path.expand("../../lib/iex_claw/tools/edit_file.ex", __DIR__))

Path is relative to agents/code/ → up two → lib/iex_claw/tools/.

Process:
  1. read_file code.exs offset=500 limit=600 (find the Mix.install block)
  2. edit_file with ONE edit inserting the 3 require lines right after Mix.install(...)'s closing bracket
  3. Report what you did
